Create a DBI metadata interface

Source: R/database-explorer.R
db_metadata.Rd

The returned functions use DBI's portable table and field listing. SQLite additionally exposes views from its catalog. Driver packages can use this small callback protocol when building their own metadata views; the explorer does not yet have an adapter registry.

Usage

db_metadata(connection)

Arguments

connection

A db_connection() wrapper or open DBI connection.

Value

A list with schemas(), tables(schema), views(schema), columns(table, schema), and quote(identifier) functions.
